source: measured on BDS 1.26.51 with the bds-sweep blocks job, 2026-10-29 UTC

conventions.arena: stone floor at y=-61, survival player standing on it (feet y=-60), noon, clear sky
conventions.faces: 0 down, 1 up, 2 north (-z), 3 south (+z), 4 west (-x), 5 east (+x)
conventions.ticks: server ticks after the command or order; a change at tick n was first seen n ticks later
conventions.cells: block name and full state map of each watched cell after the step
conventions.packets: server packets received after the step, identical ones merged with a "times" count; block runtime ids are written as the block state they denote; block updates have flags 3 and layer 0 unless listed
